description: This Java source file defines the SyncAdapterDriver class, an Android Activity that manages synchronization adapters, including binding/unbinding services, starting/canceling syncs, and displaying available sync adapters and accounts.

classes.name: SyncAdapterDriver
classes.description: An Android Activity that manages sync adapters, including binding/unbinding services, starting/canceling syncs, and displaying available sync adapters and accounts.

classes.name: SyncAdaptersCache
classes.description: A cache class for managing and parsing sync adapter service information.

classes.name: MyServiceConnection
classes.description: Inner class implementing ServiceConnection and ISyncContext.Stub to manage sync adapter service connections.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and loads sync adapters.

methods.name: getSyncAdapters
methods.description: Retrieves all registered sync adapters and populates the spinner.

methods.name: updateUi
methods.description: Updates the UI elements based on current connection and binding state.

methods.name: startSyncSelected
methods.description: Initiates sync for the selected account after user selection.

methods.name: startSync
methods.description: Starts sync for a specific account.

methods.name: onServiceChanged
methods.description: Callback when a sync service changes, refreshes the list of sync adapters.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates dialogs, such as account picker.

methods.name: onItemClick
methods.description: Handles account selection from the list.

methods.name: initiateBind
methods.description: Binds to the selected sync adapter service.

methods.name: initiateUnbind
methods.description: Unbinds from the current sync adapter service.

methods.name: getSelectedSyncAdapter
methods.description: Returns the currently selected sync adapter info.
